per_depth.shortcut_name: parabola coincidence reduces every constraint to inequality
per_depth.common_affordance: The fixed point (4,16) lies on the same parabola y=x^2 as all possible P and Q points, so a constraint is valid exactly when its two endpoint values differ.
The non-degenerate-triangle condition is treated as exactly the inequality c_u != c_v, reducing the problem to 3-coloring.
The displayed quadratic energy factors into $(x-c_u)(x-c_v)$, making every constraint exactly the graph-coloring condition $c_u \ne c_v$.

The explicit three-valued arithmetic predicate can be recognized or tabulated as a graph 3-coloring constraint: F is divisible by 3 exactly when the two assigned values have the same residue modulo 3.
